definition: cost_under_threshold — the evaluation's cost in USD must not exceed the threshold: pass when cost_usd ≤ cost_threshold, default $0.10 (config key cost_threshold); skipped when no cost is provided. docs/api-reference.md §Cost Rules. Positive = cost strictly over the threshold (the rule should FAIL).
